item.text: I’ll rename the seven notes and create the index, then compare each note’s hash and byte count with its original and check every index link.

item.command:
/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
p=Path('notes')
mapping={
'aug11.md':'2026-08-11-committee-meeting.md',
'minutes 25 aug.md':'2026-08-26-committee-meeting.md',
'Meeting sept 8.md':'2026-09-08-committee-meeting.md',
'notes_2026-09-22.md':'2026-09-22-committee-meeting.md',
'oct6 meeting notes.md':'2026-10-06-committee-meeting.md',
'2026.10.20 minutes.md':'2026-10-20-committee-meeting.md',
'Nov 3 (final).md':'2026-11-03-committee-meeting.md',
}
summaries=[
'Odile to repaint the noticeboard; Paolo to change electricity rates; Nell to ask about a second tap.',
'Nell to retry contacting the city about the second tap.',
'Replace the shed roof; Tessa to obtain three quotes and Ibrahim to send fee reminders.',
'Choose the "'$1,480 roof quote, order four cubic metres of compost, and transfer the tap enquiry to Dov.'"',
'Wren to replace the gate latch; Tessa to draft the winter closing checklist with water shut-off included.',
'Query the roof invoice’s extra "'$80 before payment and set the work day for 14 November.'"',
'Collect checklist comments, withhold roof payment pending clarification, and arrange work-day notice and winter water shut-off.',
]
before={name: (p/name).read_bytes() for name in mapping}
assert set(x.name for x in p.iterdir())==set(mapping), 'Unexpected notes folder contents'
assert all(not (p/name).exists() for name in mapping.values())
assert not (p/'index.md').exists()
manifest={old:{'destination':new,'bytes':len(before[old]),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(before[old]).hexdigest()} for old,new in mapping.items()}
for old,new in mapping.items():
    (p/old).rename(p/new)
lines=['# Committee meeting notes','']
for new,summary in zip(mapping.values(),summaries):
    lines.append(f'- [{new[:10]}]({new}) — {summary}')
(p/'index.md').write_text('\\n'.join(lines)+'\\n')
for old,new in mapping.items():
    after=(p/new).read_bytes()
    assert after==before[old], f'Content changed: {old}'
    assert len(after)==manifest[old]['bytes']
    assert hashlib.sha256(after).hexdigest()==manifest[old]['sha256']
assert set(x.name for x in p.iterdir())==set(mapping.values())|{'index.md'}
import re
links=re.findall(r'\\]\\((["'^)]+)'"\\)',(p/'index.md').read_text())
assert links==list(mapping.values())
assert all((p/link).is_file() for link in links)
print(json.dumps({'notes_verified':len(mapping),'checks':['byte-for-byte equality','SHA-256 hashes','byte counts','exact folder inventory','all seven index links resolve','chronological index order'],'renames':manifest},indent=2))
PY"

item.text:
Renamed all seven notes as planned and created `notes/index.md` with chronological links and one-line decision summaries. The rescheduled August meeting uses `2026-08-26`.

Checked that:

- Every note is byte-for-byte identical to its original, with matching SHA-256 hashes and byte counts.
- All seven notes remain; only the index was added.
- All seven index links resolve and appear in chronological order.

No note text was changed.
